recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-20909. Broader future questions about static multi-patient teams, HealthcareService links, or additional CareTeam categories should be handled under their own Jira issues rather than changing this completed event-scope clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-20909 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care clarification asking the CareTeam introduction to stop implying that CareTeam only covers a single patient or group and to include event assignment before a subject is identified, such as a code blue or emergency response team.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites commit 4639ce74485a86649aaa2ea3b45075cca3a3810e, which rewrote the CareTeam introduction into a single patient/group/event bullet list and updated the CareTeam spreadsheet row with GF#20909.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini. Later CareTeam work, including FHIR-25290 and R6 QA wording changes in 4a0a529fd303f069476d64348bb4b259ca1e1f6a, refined surrounding wording and added care teams/participate wording while preserving the patient/group/event list. Related Zulip threads quote or rely on the event/code-blue scope and raise separate modeling questions, but no final later decision was found that reverses FHIR-20909.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/careteam/careteam-introduction.xml already says CareTeam is assigned to a single patient, a group, or an event before a subject is identified, and structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml no longer narrows the resource to patient/group only.
